The 90.6% combines retrieval+judge model performance; transferring it to a different judge or different distribution is non-trivial.

condition_shift.current_state: P9 deliberation harness uses same embedder + judge but different distribution (claudex-v3 deliberation moments, not LongMemEval-style episodic recall)
